name.notAllowed: That project name cannot be used. Choose another.
name.badChars: A project name cannot contain slashes, colons, asterisks and the like, or end with a space or a dot.
name.device: The system reserves that name. Choose another.
name.taken: The name “{{name}}” is taken. Choose another.
name.linked: The name “{{name}}” is already used by another folder. Choose another.

folder.missing: That folder is not there — it may have been moved or deleted.
folder.notAFolder: That is a file, not a folder.
folder.notProject: That folder is not a wiki yet. Use “Import as a new project” instead.
folder.badMode: That is not a way of opening a folder this program knows.
folder.alreadyManaged: That folder is already one of the projects — pick it from the list.
folder.needsName: That folder's name cannot be a project name. Choose one.

llm.notConfigured: No model service is configured yet. Open Settings and enter the connection details.

provider.notConfigured: No web search is set up yet. Open Settings, choose a search service and add its key.
provider.misconfigured: The web search settings are incomplete. Check them.
provider.failed: The web search did not go through. Try again later.

settings.invalid: One of the values cannot be saved as written: {{field}}.
settings.locked: {{field}} comes from the environment the app was started with, so the settings screen cannot change it.
settings.briefTooLong: The description is longer than {{limit}} characters.
settings.searchOff: Web search is off, so it cannot be tested. Choose a search service first.
settings.probeRejected: The model service refused the key. Check the key and the service address.
settings.probeUnreachable: Could not reach the model service. Check the address and the network.
settings.probeFailed: The model service answered, but not with a usable reply.
settings.searchRejected: The search service refused the key. Check it and try again.
settings.searchUnreachable: Could not reach the search service. Check the network.
settings.searchFailed: The search service answered, but the trial search did not come back.

update.unreachable: Could not reach the update source. Check the network and try again.
update.badManifest: The update source answered with something that could not be read; it may not be ready yet.
update.badSource: The update source address is invalid; it must start with http:// or https://.
